collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS - LIVING CULTURE X: GROWING UP, GROWING OLD AND EVERYDAY JOY (LCJ-01..50, draft, 2026-11-18)
The rest of the owner's 100 Living Culture ideas and the world-inspired 50: secret languages and forgotten words, coming of age, elders who will not retire, healers' oaths, failed discoveries, masks and clothes and masterpieces nobody wanted, talent shows, ridiculous hats and the day nobody worked.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. The owner waived the review ("I'm sure the draft events are fine"); every event passed the Isola rules and the final 15-point review, logged in the notes.

collection.description: Visiting merchants offer rare shells for a season of fish, and some think it unfair: haggle hard, or ask the whole village first.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: Merchants have offered beautiful rare shells for a whole season's dried fish. (subject) says the shells are worth it. (friend) says a whole season of fish is the village's food, and the merchants are taking advantage. What should the village do?

text_only.reason: food in the story (a meal, a catch, fruit); the village's stores do not change -- the draft's notes: everything but the marked effects is story only

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: (friend) haggles for two days and gets the shells for half a season's fish. The merchants grumble that Isola is a hard place to trade. (friend) takes it as a compliment.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: The gathering decides: no trade at all. Food first. The merchants leave. (subject) is disappointed. That dry season, the village has enough fish, and nobody misses the shells.
